segments.name: Integrated cross-border logistics
segments.description: Provides integrated cross-border logistics and air freight forwarding from Hong Kong to Australia and New Zealand for e-commerce merchants.
segments.evidence: The single segment represents the Company's core business of providing (i) integrated cross-border logistics services; and (ii) air freight forwarding services.

revenueModel.text: E-commerce merchants and platform operators pay for integrated cross-border logistics and air freight forwarding from Hong Kong to Australia and New Zealand.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers are primarily enterprise customers, being e-commerce merchants or operators of e-commerce platforms, providing business-to-consumer (B2C) transactions.
